decisions.text:
DECISIONS · 2026-09-28 (Nikita)

1B overview chosen: signature dishes first, then a compact flavor block, then a culture teaser. Images are easier to take in than a radar at first glance.

Added after review: a "See all 13 ›" link at the right of the "Start with these" header (chosen over a "+9 more" last tile, so all four tiles stay real dishes and it matches "Open region ›"). The fixed "See all N dishes" button stays too: an entry at the top and at the bottom.

2B tiles chosen for Explore. Explore is browsing, and a 64px thumbnail is an icon, not a picture. 2A rows stay the pattern for the at-the-restaurant view and search results (dense, fast).

2B conditions:
• Clamp taglines to 2 lines and give the name a fixed height so tiles align
• A one-dish region: accept the half row, or span the full width
• Final call after #36 produces real Mexico illustrations; if they're muddy at tile size, fall back to 2A

Also agreed: two dish states (#40), no heart. Region heading is a title, not a card. Search and filters only on the All-dishes level. Grouped by removed from Explore.

Roadmap: #39, #40 in docs/roadmap/priorities.md
